description:
## 1.36.0-dev.114 (2026-08-10)

- Reddit: use one logical Compose comment selection for I/K navigation after entering the comment list.
- Reddit: move directly between Reddit's native collapse/expand comment semantics nodes, skipping author, Reply, and More child controls.
- Reddit: keep one matching tint and O target, including across collapse/expand row replacement.
- Reddit: clear competing child focus in comment mode and return control to Reddit at the visible boundary.
- Reddit: never fall through to collapse an unrelated comment when a selected node becomes invalid.
- Reddit: leave P preview behavior unchanged.
